items.q: I know Peanuts, that years later he played with Count Basie and what have you. But as far as the other members, the saxophone player, alto sax, his name was Don Stovall, and, of course, as the years went on by, you lose track of these fellows.

ctx.x: Not that I -- I don't quite remember. I know Peanuts, that years later he played with Count Basie and what have you. But as far as the other members, the saxophone
x no. Charlie Barnet, Don Redman. Cob Collogay's small band

player, alto sax, his name was Don Stovall, and, of course, as the years went on by, you lose track of these fellows. But Peanuts, he was quite a trumpeter, and you heard more about him as the years went by. And I hadn't even left the band to venture further, further near home, that is.
